programs.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation
programs.sub_title: Beaufort, North Carolina Beach House Remodel
programs.desc: Hoping to create memories, a couple from Durham is searching for a Beaufort, NC beach home to share with family and rent out. But with access to fishing, boating, and beautiful beaches driving up prices, their dream depends on finding an affordable fixer.

programs.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation
programs.sub_title: Young Family Seeks Cozy Beach Hideaway in Emerald Isle
programs.desc: A Virginia couple is excited to finally pursue their dreams of owning a beach home in Emerald Isle, North Carolina; with their sons growing up quickly, they hope to build unforgettable memories by renovating a property with both personality and potential.

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.desc: Chase and his team renovate an off-the-grid hunting cabin deep in the woods of Oxford, Maine; they have a budget of $20,000 and a time frame of six weeks, but they may not be able to overcome the challenges and finish the cabin before winter comes.

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.desc: Chase and the Cabin Masters team attempt to restore a family camp that sisters Charlene Andersen and Pennilyn Dudley fondly recall many stories of from the last 50 years.

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.desc: A family purchases land on Sebec Lake and acquires an old shipping container they hope the team can transform into a dream cabin; the crew is challenged by the metal walls as they tackle the build offsite before transporting it to its forever home.

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.sub_title: Form, Function and Fun on Flying Pond
programs.desc: A family loves their cozy, hilltop camp even though it lacks some basic amenities that make year-round visits difficult; the Cabin Masters employ all their skills to transform this unfinished gem from driveway to dock.

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.desc: Two newlyweds call on the Cabin Masters to expand the 1957 Great Pond cabin they inherited to include enough space for their family, which includes three children, their spouses and six grandchildren.

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.desc: Chase and his team renovate an off-the-grid camp for a family of city slickers; with limited resources, the team members work to incorporate the comforts of city living, then they discover a moldering water tank that may shut down the renovation.
